$comment: Every KPost account this bench itself CREATED during a test run — the opposite of
test-accounts.json, which is exclusively the PRE-EXISTING, .env-declared accounts.
Appended to, never overwritten, by src/fixtures/created-accounts.ts's recordCreatedAccount().
Each entry is the kpostID and mobile number a signup/registration flow actually minted, so a
newly-created identity is never lost track of across runs. Committed to the repo (no secrets:
a kpostID and mobile are identifiers, not credentials).
